body:
All registered work is completed, no open or deferred findings/blockers remain, and each final Verify is current with passed referenced evidence and approved referenced reviews under current record-level applicability. No private journal/lock requires recovery. Earlier failed proof and drift remain historical and are not relabeled; old Verify limits exclude hosted/publication/customer claims and broader follow-ups. FU-012–018 and unrelated baseline prose/legacy debt retain their owning follow-up surfaces and do not require reopening these v2 stores; future selected work receives a new v3 assessment. Existing RC/Test/Skill/Design/Release/Distribution authority remains in current governing models; linked adoption records remain readable provenance. M2 must reconcile the identified artifact-lifecycle/metadata/selector and canonical skill/package consumers in the same removal unit so that they no longer operationally validate these archived roots. This is not new adoption or renewed correctness of those models. No external customer-root completion is inferred. Supporting baseline 93bfff4b retains original v2 operations if a concrete contrary dependency is found before removal; do not migrate or ship a fallback reader. The selected historical files must remain byte-identical. Exact inspected store revisions:

decisions.rationale: Apply the approved retirement direction through existing owners: RF-SR-14, CLI-SR-28, WF-SR-18, RC-SR-21 and SYS-SR-02/04/06/08/09. Retire the stored contract only after explicit operational-dependency disposition and reviewed coherent implementation/Verify. Preserve independent transport versions, historical provenance and v3 safety; remove v2-only tests without adding retirement/rejection/archive-compatibility tests.

Under the user-authorized retirement and approved WF-SR-18/TG-00 boundary, disposition the twelve exact selected local v2 stores as historical evidence eligible for operational support removal. This is an explicit responsible coordination decision based on complete selected CLI context, final referenced proof/judgments, applicable Verify limits and current recovery observations, not completion inferred from labels.
